name: Apache Solr (LTR / ConfigSet / scripting RCE class)

vendor.company: Apache Software Foundation (Apache Solr / Apache Lucene project; PMC-governed). Originally created at CNET (2004), donated to ASF 2006.
vendor.hq: Apache Software Foundation, Wilmington, Delaware, USA (project is distributed/volunteer; major commercial backers include Lucidworks)
vendor.scale: Apache top-level project; github.com/apache/solr ~1.3k+ stars (mirror; primary dev on ASF infra/JIRA SOLR). One of the two dominant OSS search engines (alongside Elasticsearch/OpenSearch). Powers search at large enterprises; bundled in many CMS/data products (e.g. historically Drupal, Magento, DSpace, HBase/HDFS stacks, Lucidworks Fusion). Tens of thousands of internet-reachable instances historically observed on 8983.

verification_primitive.probe: GET http://<host>:8983/solr/admin/info/system?wt=json  (read-only, unauthenticated). Fallback liveness: GET http://<host>:8983/solr/ for the Admin UI HTML.
verification_primitive.success_signal: HTTP 200 with JSON containing a 'lucene' object holding 'solr-spec-version'/'solr-impl-version' and a 'system' block (uptime, solr_home, OS/JVM). If auth is on you get HTTP 401 with a WWW-Authenticate header (Basic/Bearer) or a 403. 200-with-data = open; 401/403 = surface present, access not exercised.
verification_primitive.impact_when_open: Confirms unauthenticated read of full server/version metadata and the path to core/collection enumeration (/admin/cores?action=STATUS, /admin/collections?action=LIST) and document dumps (/<core>/select?q=*:*). Establishes exact version for CVE scoping (Velocity/ConfigSet/backup-restore/PKI-bypass RCE chains) without any write.

endpoints.returns: Admin UI AngularJS SPA. HTML Solr Admin, header Apache SOLR, ng-app="solrAdminApp". Strongest unauth fingerprint.
Unauth JSON: full Solr/Lucene spec+impl versions, JVM, OS, solr_home path, uptime, mode (cloud/standalone). Primary version + recon read.
Java system properties. Historically leaked secrets (only props containing 'password' were masked; basicauth/aws.secretKey exposed) pre-9.3 / pre-8.11.2.
Lists all cores, their dataDir, index size, doc counts. Enumerates every dataset on the node, unauth.
(SolrCloud) Lists all collections. Maps the indexed corpus.
Dumps indexed documents (the actual data) when no auth. The data-exposure read.
(LTR module enabled) Lists LTR feature stores; PUT uploads features. Reveals/controls ranking features.
(LTR) Lists ML ranking models; PUT uploads a model; DELETE removes one. Model-store write surface.
(SolrCloud) Browses ZooKeeper tree incl. cluster config and (mis)stored security.json.
Config API: write solrconfig overlays (add request handlers, <lib> classpath, response writers). The config-write -> RCE pivot (CVE-2025-24814, CVE-2019-17558 class).
